events.text: Constellation Software's Harris Operating Group (N. Harris Computer Corporation) agreed to acquire Allscripts Healthcare Solutions' Hospitals and Large Physician Practices business segment (Sunrise, Paragon, Allscripts TouchWorks, Allscripts Opal, dbMotion) for up to US$700 million: a fixed US$670 million paid at closing plus up to US$30 million of contingent consideration over two years. The segment had 2021 gross revenue of US$928 million. The deal was expected to close in Q2 2022.
events.source_title: Constellation Software's Harris Operating Group Acquires Allscripts Hospitals and Large Physician Practices Business Segment

events.text: Constellation Software and its subsidiary Lumine Group Inc. completed the purchase of 100% of WideOrbit Inc. (a US media vertical-market software provider) on February 22, 2023. WideOrbit became a Lumine Group subsidiary. Following payment of a dividend-in-kind on February 23, 2023 (3.0003833 Lumine subordinate voting shares per Constellation common share held as of the February 16, 2023 record date), Lumine Group was spun out as a separate public company, with Lumine shares beginning to trade on the TSX Venture Exchange around March 24, 2023 under symbol 'LMN'.
events.source_title: Constellation Software Inc. and Lumine Group Inc. Complete Purchase of WideOrbit Inc. and Lumine Group Spin-Out

events.text: Constellation Software's Perseus Operating Group completed its acquisition of Black Knight's Empower loan origination system and Optimal Blue businesses on September 15, 2023, after entering into the purchase agreement with Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) and Black Knight in July 2023. Total consideration was approximately US$700 million: US$200 million cash plus a US$500 million promissory note. The sale was undertaken to help secure FTC antitrust clearance of ICE's acquisition of Black Knight.
events.source_title: Constellation Software's Perseus Group Completes Acquisition of Black Knight's Empower and Optimal Blue Businesses

events.text: Mark Leonard resigned as President of Constellation Software, effective immediately, citing health reasons. The Board appointed Mark Miller, Constellation's Chief Operating Officer for over thirty years, as President; Miller's other roles were unchanged. Leonard remained a Director on the Board. Shares fell 5.5% to C$3,910.71 on the news, erasing roughly C$4.8 billion of market capitalization.
events.source_title: Constellation Software Inc. Announces the Resignation of Mark Leonard and Appointment of Mark Miller as President of Constellation Software

events.text: Constellation Software announced that founder and former President Mark Leonard will not stand for re-election to the Board of Directors, with his term ending after the May 15, 2026 annual shareholders' meeting. Leonard is expected to remain involved as an advisor on Constellation's Permanent Engaged Minority Shareholder strategy. This follows his September 2025 resignation as President.
events.source_title: Constellation Software Inc. Announces Mark Leonard's Decision to not Stand for Re-Election to Board of Directors

events.text: Constellation Software's Perseus Operating Group completed the acquisition of Auto-IT Pty Ltd, a dealer management system provider for the automotive, agriculture, trucking and construction equipment markets. Purchase price was not disclosed; this search pass could not confirm whether it exceeded USD 100 million.
events.source_title: Perseus Operating Group of Constellation Software Completes Acquisition of Auto-IT Group

events.text: Constellation Software acquired TECVIA, a Munich-based provider of media and training solutions for the mobility sector. Purchase price was not disclosed.
